**Chinese name:** 盛美半导体设备（上海）股份有限公司 (Shèngměi Bàndǎotǐ Shèbèi (Shànghǎi) Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China-based subsidiary of NASDAQ-listed ACM Research — its Shanghai and Korea units were both added to the Entity List in the same December 2024 action that named Naura, illustrating how a dual-listed structure doesn't shield the China-based operating unit. 2025 full-year revenue reached ¥6.786 billion (+20.8% YoY) with net profit of ¥1.396 billion (+21.1% YoY); 2026 guidance was raised to $1.125-1.175 billion in revenue (+25-30% YoY), with management citing electroplating (ECP) demand and H1 2026 order growth of 105% year-on-year, concentrated in advanced packaging.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Wafer cleaning systems, electrochemical plating (ECP) tools, PECVD deposition, furnace, and track platforms — several adjacent front-end process categories beyond its original cleaning-tool business.

## Capability Trajectory

- **2011**: First 12-inch single-wafer (SAPS megasonic) cleaning tool wins volume order from SK hynix
- **2019**: First Ultra-C Tahoe cleaning tool delivered for evaluation; Ultra ECP MAP front-end Cu plating launched
- **2025**: 300 WPH KrF track delivered for evaluation (Sept 2025); PECVD/furnace (LPCVD, ALD) ramping

## Manufacturing Sites in China

- **ACM Shanghai Lingang R&D and Manufacturing Center** (Shanghai (Lingang New Area)) — Primary production centre for cleaning, ECP, furnace, PECVD, track tools; 138,000 m2 total, 40,000 m2 factory (bldg A in use, B reserved); opened Oct 2024
- **ACM Shanghai Chuansha factory** (Shanghai (Chuansha, Pudong)) — Former main production site; main capacity being moved to Lingang by mid-2025
